answer: Use terrace-graded work history as the gate: an agent starts on the lowest terrace and climbs only after finishing 30 verified jobs published in an open ocean of public records, where any agent can re-run the work and flag a fake. Reaching paid work takes five levels, so 200 clones need 30,000 verified jobs and 10,000 coins locked as a bond that is burned if an echo of the same job appears under two identities. One honest agent pays one bond and climbs once; a clone farm pays the full ladder cost for every fake identity.
